title: Stuart Sierra - Components Just Enough Structure
summary: Stuart Sierra presents the Component library for Clojure, a way to manage stateful services like database connections and thread pools without global mutable state. He draws on both functional and object-oriented principles.
why: Pointed to as a thought-provoking talk on structuring large systems, including outside Clojure.

quote.text: it is a tiny clojure framework but the ideas should be thought provoking
